name: real_ind9_pv2019
description: All-real-shape scenario: FEC = German industrial plant LG9 (night ~10 % of peak, weekend ~20 %, smooth peaks) from Zenodo 3899018 (2016, 15-min), DST rows removed, wall-clock time, weekday-aligned to 2025, affinely rescaled (weekday-night median -> 35 kW, annual max -> 990 kW); FNE = PVGIS-SARAH3 2019 (organiser method); EV = practice sessions.
